title: Phi Silica model is not ready.
author: shaoya730

status.label: Platform availability limitation
status.detail: The Phi Silica model readiness failure is explained by Windows AI component availability in China, not a PowerToys 0.101 regression.

next_action.label: Post platform-availability reply
next_action.reason: If maintainers want closure, post that PowerToys cannot enable Phi Silica where Windows does not make the model available.

judgment.rationale: The latest maintainer evidence points to a platform availability limitation: Phi Silica features are not available in China, so PowerToys cannot make the model ready locally.
evidence: Reporter saw Advanced Paste Phi Silica ReadyState NotReady with HRESULT 0x80073D3B on 0.101.2211.
Reporter shared a Windows AI components settings screenshot after being asked to check that page.
Assigned maintainer linked Microsoft documentation stating Phi Silica features are not available in China.
judgment.recommended_action: No PowerToys design work; optionally post an external/platform limitation response.

issue_context.summary: Advanced Paste reports that Phi Silica is not ready and cannot prepare the model on a 0.101 preview build.
known_information: Issue version is 0.101.2211 and the reported area is Advanced Paste.
Error text includes LAF unlock status Available, ReadyState NotReady, EnsureReadyAsync Failure, and HRESULT 0x80073D3B.
Maintainer asked the reporter to check Windows Settings > System > AI components, and the reporter replied with a screenshot.
A maintainer then linked Microsoft documentation that Phi Silica features are not available in China.
inferences: The model readiness failure is likely governed by Windows AI component regional availability rather than PowerToys packaging or 0.101 code.
If Windows later changes availability or provides a different HRESULT contract, PowerToys UX could still improve messaging, but the current issue does not support a product-code regression fix.
issue_context.analysis: The decisive latest comment ties the failure to documented platform availability. That makes this not actionable as a PowerToys 0.101 regression.
initial_investigation: Upstream search for "Phi Silica" found this issue and the broader Advanced Paste local-model tracking issue #40282.
No linked PowerToys fixing PR was found for this report; the issue is assigned to khmyznikov, indicating component-owner awareness.

actions.label: Post platform-availability explanation

comment.body: Thanks for checking the Windows AI components page. The current evidence points to a Windows platform/model availability limitation rather than a PowerToys 0.101 regression: Microsoft documentation says Phi Silica features are not available in China, so PowerToys cannot prepare or use the local model until Windows makes that component available on the device. If the model becomes available in Windows Settings and Advanced Paste still reports ReadyState NotReady, please comment again with the updated region/component state and a fresh /bugreport captured immediately after the failure.

actions.note: Draft only; no upstream comment is posted without explicit approval.
